286310
TOK=$(printf 'protocol=https\nhost=github.com\n\n' | timeout 10 git credential fill 2>/dev/null | sed -n 's/^password=//p' | head -1)
[ -z "$TOK" ] && TOK=$(grep -oE 'gh[cp]_[A-Za-z0-9]+' /root/.git-credentials 2>/dev/null | head -1)
API="https://api.github.com/repos/Thousands91/-1/contents/remote/hb_286310.txt"
REBASE=$(ls -d /root/asar-sync/.git/rebase-* 2>/dev/null | tr '\n' ' ')
PID=$(cat /root/.remote_pid 2>/dev/null)
PBOXN=$(ls /root/.remote_pending/ 2>/dev/null|wc -l)
PBOXSZ=$(du -sh /root/.remote_pending 2>/dev/null|cut -f1)
HB="HB286310 $(date '+%F %T')
loop_pid=$PID alive=$(kill -0 $PID 2>/dev/null && echo yes || echo no)
rebase_state=${REBASE:-none}
pbox=${PBOXN}个/${PBOXSZ}
git_status=$(cd /root/asar-sync && git status --short 2>/dev/null | head -5 | tr '\n' '|')
"
B64=$(printf '%s' "$HB" | base64 -w0)
timeout 30 curl -s -X PUT -H "Authorization: token $TOK" -d "{\"message\":\"hb286310\",\"content\":\"$B64\"}" "$API" | grep -q '"content"' && echo "心跳文件已写" || echo "心跳文件写失败"
# 修复:中止残留rebase + 清PBOX + 更新脚本
cd /root/asar-sync && git rebase --abort 2>/dev/null; git reset --hard origin/main >/dev/null 2>&1
rm -f /root/.remote_pending/*
echo "" | base64 -d > /tmp/v66.new && bash -n /tmp/v66.new && cp /tmp/v66.new /root/remote_ctl_v6.sh && chmod +x /root/remote_ctl_v6.sh && echo "v6.6已就位" || echo "脚本更新失败"
echo "==完=="
